messages:
Leah: FYI, seeing a spike in GPU attach tail latency in eu-west3 over the past 25m, correlate with local NVMe temp rise on a small node set.
Ravi: Which node set? scrub or scrub-trigger?
Leah: it's cohort-D (gnode-eu3-22{1..4}). Firmware kicked full-scrub when temps crossed ~66C. Background scrub -> IO saturation -> attach retries.
Marta: Are we hitting readonly or SMART errors yet?
Leah: no SMARTs, no readonly. Attaches are slow (~500-1200ms wait), autoscaler misreads capacity as healthy but queueing grows.
Kai: paste the kernel lines if you have them.
Leah: ```
[ 2156.123456] nvme2: temp=67C fw=fw-2025-09 scrub escalated full-scan
[ 2157.234567] nvme2: write_amp=3.2 -> 5.1 io_wait=280ms
[ 2158.345678] attach_coordinator: attach_wait=900ms retries=3
```
Ravi: 5.1 WA is rough. Could be firmware changed GC window or scrub heuristics. Any config drift?
Leah: config looks normal. This firmware was pushed two weeks ago in eu-west3 only.
Marta: Can we reduce janitor concurrency for that pool and add backpressure? We did that previously with good effect.
Kai: Also add a routing preference to avoid these nodes for new attaches. That buys time without full region failover.
Leah: plan: 1) set janitor.pool.cohort-d.concurrency=1 and max_io_mb_per_sec=60, 2) lower router weight for gnode-eu3-22* to 0.04, 3) monitor attach tails for 1h, 4) open vendor ticket for fw-2025-09.
Ravi: Sounds good. What's the expected customer impact if we prefer other regions?
Leah: slight increase in RPC latencies for customers with eu-west3 affinity (~15-35ms) and modest egress internal cost (~10-15%). Less than potential SLA hits if we let attach tail persist.
Marta: Downside: scrub backlog grows and wear may increase longer term. But safer short-term.
Leah: executing now. Commands: ```
# throttle janitor for cohort-d
jq '.pools["cohort-d"].concurrency=1 | .pools["cohort-d"].max_io_mb_per_sec=60' /etc/janitor/config.yaml > /tmp/janitor.patch && sudo mv /tmp/janitor.patch /etc/janitor/config.yaml && sudo systemctl reload janitor
# deprioritize nodes in router
redis-cli HSET router:node_weights "gnode-eu3-22" 0.04
```
janitor-bot: janitor config updated for cohort-d (concurrency=1, max_io_mb_per_sec=60). Restart scheduled, changes rolling within ~45s.
Leah: router weights applied. New smart-router logs show reduced traffic to gnode-eu3-22*.
Kai: any immediate change in attach latencies?
Leah: dashboards show tail down ~40% within 2m. Still watching for oscillations.
Ravi: can someone run a quick cost calc for a 24h partial region shift vs SLA penalty estimates? I'll need it for postmortem.
Marta: i'll pull numbers. Also open a tracking ticket with vendor asking if fw-2025-09 adjusted scrub thresholds. Include dmesg and WA samples.
Leah: created ticket INF-4521 and linked logs. I'll put an incident note if SMARTs appear or any node goes readonly.
Kai: nice triage. Add a scheduled job to re-increase janitor concurrency after scrub cools; maybe ramp rather than immediate switch.
Leah: will add a cron: check temps every 10m, if <62C for 30m then concurrency=2, <58C then restore.
Ravi: +1. Follow-up: run a firmware-rollback test on one spare node in staging to reproduce and confirm.
Marta: tagging eng-runtime and infra-owners on the ticket.
Leah: thanks team. Monitoring keep me posted. :thumbsup:
